name.zh: 徒手单腿罗马尼亚硬拉

purpose.zh: 练腘绳肌拉长下的控制，后侧又稳又有力
purpose.en: Build hamstring control in a lengthened position for a strong, stable back line.

text.zh: 支撑腿膝微屈，以髋为轴向前折
text.en: Soften the standing knee and hinge forward from the hip

text.zh: 后腿与躯干成一条直线，骨盆端平
text.en: Keep the back leg in line with your torso and your hips level.

text.zh: 手臂自然下垂，背部保持平直
text.en: Let your arms hang straight down and keep your back flat.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back or letting the pelvis open out.

cautions.zh: 全程保持腰椎中立，腰部发紧或疼痛时减小幅度
cautions.en: Keep your lower back neutral, and reduce the range if it feels tight or painful.
